candidate_relations.reason: The clinical picture (pedunculated tubular ureteral mass, negative malignancy biopsies, young-to-middle-aged presentation, filling defect on urography) is classic for fibroepithelial polyp. 'Ureteral polyp, benign' maps directly to fibroepithelial polyp as its standard clinical synonym; no incompatible subtype, anatomy, or scope difference exists.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Fibroepithelial polyp of the ureter is the canonical benign ureteral polyp; 'ureteral polyp, benign' is a recognized alias for the same entity

case_quality_flags: Negative urine cytology and biopsy strongly support benign fibroepithelial polyp over urothelial carcinoma, increasing diagnostic confidence
